summary: Borr Drilling Ltd filed a Form 6-K announcing the pricing and upsize of a $2.035 billion offering of senior secured notes due 2032 and 2034 through its subsidiaries, upsized by $435 million. Proceeds will refinance $1.128 billion of 10.000% Senior Secured Notes due 2028 and $770.7 million of 10.375% Senior Secured Notes due 2030, plus general corporate purposes. Settlement is expected by June 10, 2026, subject to customary conditions. This is a debt refinancing transaction, not a special situation.
